title: Java Testing
intro: Testing interviews test whether you understand testing as a strategy, not just whether you write tests. This module is an elevation arc: it opens with unit-testing basics and TDD (the foundation), then Mockito (the mocking tool every Java test uses). Integration testing and Spring Boot testing are the framework tier, then Testcontainers (the modern integration approach). Testing strategies, automation, and contract testing follow, then the specialized tiers — performance, chaos. Unit-testing advanced closes the depth tier, then comparisons and scenario-based questions.
